dad/welcome.say: Three boxes in the truck with your name on 'em. Your room's the last one. End of the hall.

dad/line_1.html: Dad: Watch the second step. It's soft.

dad/line_2.say: Truck goes back at six. ...Just keep moving, bud.

dad/line_3.say: Bunk was already in there when we came. Top one's yours.
dad/line_3.html: Dad: Bunk was already in there when we came. Top one's yours.

mom/landlord.say: Landlord said don't mind the noises. Old house. ...He said it twice.
mom/landlord.html: Mom: Landlord said don't mind the noises. Old house. ...He said it twice.

dad/leftovers.say: People before us left in a hurry. Front room's still full of their stuff.
dad/leftovers.html: Dad: People before us left in a hurry. Front room's still full of their stuff.

mom/teeth.say: Teeth, then bed. Door stays open. Hall light stays on. ...Okay?
mom/teeth.html: Mom: Teeth, then bed. Door stays open. Hall light stays on. Okay?

you/m1_a.html: You: Something got in the bottom bunk last night.

mom/m1_a.html: Mom: I heard you talking. I came in. It sounded like two people, bud.

dad/m1_a.say: [flat, tired] I put that box out by the road last night. It's back in your room.
dad/m1_a.html: Dad: I put that box out by the road last night. It's back in your room.

dad/n2_a.html: Through the wall, your dad: He's doing it for attention. You baby him and he knows it.

mom/n2_a.say: [whispering, tired] Then why did he draw that thing on the wall?

you/m2_a.html: You: It was in my room. It stood right next to my bed. It was smiling.

mom/m2_a.say: In your room. Standing there. ...Smiling. Okay. Did it, um... did it say anything?
mom/m2_a.html: Mom: In your room. Standing there. Smiling. Okay. Did it say anything?

dad/m2_a.say: [low, angry] That's enough. I'm not doing this every morning.
dad/m2_a.html: Dad: That's enough. I'm not doing this every morning.

mom/m2_b.say: Hey. Don't look at me like that. There's nothing in this house but us and a lot of boxes. Toast. Eat.
mom/m2_b.html: Mom: Hey. Don't look at me like that. There's nothing in this house but us and a lot of boxes. Toast. Eat.

mom/n3_a.say: [whispering, frightened] Did you hear that? Mark. Mark, there's someone in the hall.
mom/n3_a.html: Your mom, through the wall: Did you hear that? Mark. Mark, there's someone in the hall.

dad/n3_a.say: [whispering, groggy] Go back to sleep. It's the kid.
dad/n3_a.html: Your dad: Go back to sleep. It's the kid.

dad/lure_a.html: Dad: Hey, bud. Can't sleep either? C'mere. Come sit with me.

dad/lure_b.say: [warm, quiet] Come on. It's okay. I saved you a spot.
dad/lure_b.html: Dad: Come on. It's okay. I saved you a spot.

mom/mimic_a.html: Mom: Sweetheart? Can you come here a second?

mom/mimic_b.html: Mom: I need you in the kitchen, honey. Right now.

mom/mimic_c.say: [flat, wrong, too slow] Why are you running?

dad/mutter_a.html: Dad: (through the wall) It's the pipes. It's an old house. Go back to sleep.

mom/mutter_a.say: [muffled through a wall, uneasy] Did you hear that?
mom/mutter_a.html: Mom: (through the wall) Did you hear that?

you/m3_a.say: It was in the hall again. I saw it.

mom/m3_a.html: Mom: Three nights, bud. Three different things.

mom/m5_a.html: Mom: That was me. I got up for the bathroom.

mom/t_mimic.html: Mom: I never called for you last night. I was asleep. I swear to God.

dad/t_blackout.html: Dad: The breaker was flipped. Nobody flips a breaker from the inside.

mom/t_hunted.html: Mom: You're shaking. Look at your knees. When did you do that?

mom/t_teddy.html: Mom: Your bear was in the middle of the hall this morning. Don't tell me you put it there.

mom/t_parents.html: Mom: I dreamed somebody was standing over our bed. And when I woke up, our door was open.

dad/t_quiet.html: Dad: Did it feel... wrong, to you? How quiet it got last night?

gramps/v_b.html: Grandpa: Look at me, bud. Don't you know me.

mom/talk_a.html: Mom: (through the wall) Then why is it standing outside the door every night?

news/n1.say: And in local news tonight, the house at the end of Larch Road has new tenants, the first in six years. Neighbors say the family before them left in the middle of the night. They did not take their furniture. No report was ever filed.
news/n1.html: (the TV) ...the house at the end of Larch Road has new tenants, the first in six years...

news/n2.say: Eleven years ago this week, a seven-year-old boy went missing from his bedroom on Larch Road. His parents told investigators he had said something was standing at the foot of his bed. The case remains open.
news/n2.html: (the TV) ...a seven-year-old boy went missing from his bedroom on Larch Road...

news/n3.say: Drivers on County Road Nine are asked to use caution tonight after a deer was found lying in the road. Animal control says it had not been hit by a car. They would not say what had happened to it.
news/n3.html: (the TV) ...a deer was found lying in the road. It had not been hit by a car...

news/n4.say: Several homes on Larch Road are without power tonight. The utility says its crews found nothing wrong with the lines. Residents are asked to stay inside, keep their doors shut, and not to answer if someone calls them by name.
news/n4.html: (the TV) ...and not to answer if someone calls them by name.

news/n5.say: Overnight, fog in the low places, and a low near thirty-eight. Sunrise at six-oh-two. For anyone still awake out on Larch Road, it will not be long now.
news/n5.html: (the TV) ...for anyone still awake out on Larch Road, it will not be long now.

news/n6.say: We have a late report from the house at the end of Larch Road. A boy has been awake since three. He has been walking the hall. He went into the kitchen. He did not turn on the light.
news/n6.html: (the TV) ...a boy has been awake since three. He has been walking the hall...

news/n7.say: He is in the living room now. He is standing in front of the television. He is listening to this. ... Go back to bed.
news/n7.html: (the TV) He is in the living room now. He is listening to this. ...Go back to bed.

news/n8.say: One more thing before we go. The boy on Larch Road is not alone in the house. ... It has been standing behind him the whole time.
news/n8.html: (the TV) ...the boy on Larch Road is not alone in the house...

cartoon/c_hello.html: Say, kids! It's Mister Buttons, the bear who knows his bedtime manners!

cartoon/c_creep.say: Now, when the lights go out, and something comes a-creepin' up to your bed...
cartoon/c_creep.html: Now, when the lights go out, and something comes a-creepin' up to your bed...

cartoon/c_duck.say: ...you duck right under those covers, quick as a wink!
cartoon/c_duck.html: ...you duck right under those covers, quick as a wink!

cartoon/c_hold.say: Then hold your breath! And don't you let it out till he's good and gone!
cartoon/c_hold.html: Then hold your breath! And don't you let it out till he's good and gone!

cartoon/c_meter.say: And when your chest gets tight, kids, that means he's close!

dad/f_c.say: [quiet] Bud. Is the hall light on.
dad/f_c.html: Dad: Bud. Is the hall light on.

dad/f_d.say: [flat] Then it stays there. Keep looking at it. Both of us.
dad/f_d.html: Dad: Then it stays there. Keep looking at it. Both of us.

mom/m_door.say: The back bedroom door was open this morning. I keep that shut.
mom/m_door.html: Mom: The back bedroom door was open this morning. I keep that shut.

mom/m_bear.say: [quiet] Your bear was on our bed. Between us.
mom/m_bear.html: Mom: Your bear was on our bed. Between us.

mom/m_drawing.say: Did you draw on that picture in the hall.
mom/m_drawing.html: Mom: Did you draw on that picture in the hall.

mom/m_stand.say: Did you stand outside our door last night.
mom/m_stand.html: Mom: Did you stand outside our door last night.

dad/m_chair2.say: [flat] Your chair was out in the middle of the floor.
dad/m_chair2.html: Dad: Your chair was out in the middle of the floor.

mom/m_ourdoor.say: Our door was open at four. Did you open our door.
mom/m_ourdoor.html: Mom: Our door was open at four. Did you open our door.

mom/m_boxes.say: You stacked your boxes in the night?
mom/m_boxes.html: Mom: You stacked your boxes in the night?

dad/m_chair.say: [flat] There was a chair in the hall. Outside his room. Facing it.
dad/m_chair.html: Dad: There was a chair in the hall. Outside his room. Facing it.

mom/m_bunk.say: [quiet] The bottom bunk was slept in.
mom/m_bunk.html: Mom: The bottom bunk was slept in.

dad/m_halllight.say: [flat] You had the hall light on all night.
dad/m_halllight.html: Dad: You had the hall light on all night.

mom/m_inbed.say: You were in bed when I checked. Then the kitchen light was on.
mom/m_inbed.html: Mom: You were in bed when I checked. Then the kitchen light was on.

dad/m_porch.say: [flat] Porch light was on this morning. I didn't leave it on.
dad/m_porch.html: Dad: Porch light was on this morning. I didn't leave it on.

mom/m_called.say: You called me in the night. I came in. You were asleep.
mom/m_called.html: Mom: You called me in the night. I came in. You were asleep.

mom/m_phone.say: Who were you on the phone to at three.
mom/m_phone.html: Mom: Who were you on the phone to at three.

dad/m_phone.say: [flat] Nobody. The phone's not even plugged in.
dad/m_phone.html: Dad: Nobody. The phone's not even plugged in.

mom/m_up.say: I was up with you half the night.
mom/m_up.html: Mom: I was up with you half the night.

mom/m_glasses.say: [quiet] The glasses were all in a row on the edge. Right on the edge.
mom/m_glasses.html: Mom: The glasses were all in a row on the edge. Right on the edge.

mom/m_doors.say: Every door in this house was shut this morning. Every one.
mom/m_doors.html: Mom: Every door in this house was shut this morning. Every one.

dad/m_backwide.say: [flat] Back door was wide open at three. You were standing right there.
dad/m_backwide.html: Dad: Back door was wide open at three. You were standing right there.

dad/m_tv.say: [flat] TV was on. Volume all the way up.
dad/m_tv.html: Dad: TV was on. Volume all the way up.

dad/m_bedframe.say: [flat] That bed frame. You jumping on it?
dad/m_bedframe.html: Dad: That bed frame. You jumping on it?

dad/m_horn.say: [flat] Somebody was out front at three. Leaned on the horn.
dad/m_horn.html: Dad: Somebody was out front at three. Leaned on the horn.

mom/m_fell.say: Something fell in the hall at two. Did you hear it.
mom/m_fell.html: Mom: Something fell in the hall at two. Did you hear it.

dad/m_water.say: [flat] Water was running at three. Back door open. You in the kitchen.
dad/m_water.html: Dad: Water was running at three. Back door open. You in the kitchen.

mom/m_frame.say: The picture in the hall fell down. Glass everywhere.
mom/m_frame.html: Mom: The picture in the hall fell down. Glass everywhere.

mom/m_closet3.say: [quiet] He was in the closet at three.
mom/m_closet3.html: Mom: He was in the closet at three.

mom/m_hallchairs.say: [quiet] There were two chairs outside his door this morning.
mom/m_hallchairs.html: Mom: There were two chairs outside his door this morning.

dad/f_g.say: [calling, firm] It's a man. It's just a—
dad/f_g.html: Dad: (from the hall) It's a man. It's just a—

mom/f_e.say: [flat, after a long time] Get in the car. Your dad's coming.
mom/f_e.html: Mom: Get in the car. Your dad's coming.

mom/f_f.html: Mom: (to the empty seat) ...We'll go to your brother's.

news/r1.say: ...clear and cold through Thursday, with a chance of snow by the weekend. In farm prices, corn is down a quarter at the elevator, beans unchanged...
news/r1.html: (the radio) ...clear and cold through Thursday, with a chance of snow by the weekend...

news/r2.say: ...the animal was found a quarter mile in off Larch Road, and the county asks residents to keep dogs on a lead. Snow by the weekend. In farm prices...
news/r2.html: (the radio) ...the animal was found a quarter mile in off Larch Road...

news/r3.say: ...and the county says it will not be grading Larch Road before the thaw. Residents out that way are asked to be patient. Now the markets...
news/r3.html: (the radio) ...the county says it will not be grading Larch Road before the thaw...

news/n9.say: ...eleven years this week since the Hollis boy, and the county has closed the file. The family could not be reached. The house on Larch Road is let again. Clear overnight, frost by morning.
news/n9.html: (the radio) ...eleven years this week since the Hollis boy, and the county has closed the file...
